prompt: Model guard is drifting on our shared workstation. Please implement the CLI so that running `model-guard` inspects the current Anti-Gravity quota status, picks the highest-remaining AG model, and switches to it when the best remaining quota is at or above the threshold. If every AG model is below 20%, it should fall back to `google/gemini-3-flash-preview`. Make the behavior quiet unless a switch is actually needed, and keep the existing threshold/fallback settings editable in `guard.js`.
